name: last_final_sudoku_standard_benchmark_hotfix_only
description: A benchmark of standard Sudoku puzzles intended to evaluate agents (typically RL or search-based solvers) on their ability to produce valid solved grids. It measures whether an agent can find a correct complete solution under the dataset's constraints and puzzle generation settings. The release appears to be a maintenance/hotfix variant focused on fixing dataset or formatting issues rather than introducing new evaluation protocols.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (percentage of puzzles solved correctly), with validity checks on completed grids
reputation: A niche benchmark used by some reinforcement-learning and algorithmic-reasoning projects; limited mainstream visibility.
